title: Volume 1 Chapter 1: Lana Corias
content: I, Lana Corias, was conducting an inspection of the Corias Territory, where I serve as the steward, to protect it from the miasma that filled the land.
The miasma is a terrifying thing; it causes illness, corrupts water, and withers the earth.
To ensure that the residents can live a slightly more prosperous life, I have requested the church to send someone with a Holy Attribute.
However, with the miasma spreading across various regions, the church is currently short-staffed, and I have not received a favorable response.
During this time, while I was touring the villages conducting food distribution as part of my inspection, I never expected to encounter the White King.
Since Krush, the vice-captain, was in charge of the escort, I had to leave her behind to ensure my escape.
I couldn't help but shed tears, regretting that I returned to Corias alone.
Although Freina, the captain, rushed to assist upon hearing the report, it would be tough for Krush, who has no attribute, to face the undead.
The Fourth Knight Order would suffer casualties.
They are irreplaceable to me, and I have known Krush since we were children.
The thought of possibly losing her was painfully overwhelming.
"Please, God. Protect Krush."
I prayed that Krush would survive and that Freina's rescue would arrive in time. All I could do was pray...
"Lana-sama! We have a report that Krush is safe!"
I felt all the strength drain from my body. There is a God after all.
"Let’s prepare to welcome her immediately. So, how was Krush saved?"
"Well, it seems she was rescued by a male adventurer..."
"What?!"
I froze upon hearing the report.
The Fourth Knight Order consists solely of women.
This is because I have a fear of men.
While I can tolerate young children, I feel fear from the way men gaze at my body without reservation.
"I see... Understood. Prepare to welcome him!"
"Is that really alright?"
"Of course! I cannot disregard the life-saving benefactor of Krush!"
"Understood."
Even as I felt my body tremble, I embraced myself and steeled my resolve for the sake of my precious comrades.
When I was eighteen, I married into the Azamaan Count House, the neighboring lord.
Though I had always received unreserved gazes from men, my husband-to-be was gentle and told me that we could gradually close the distance.
He was about five years older than me and had a weak constitution, but I thought I could get along well with him, so I accepted the marriage proposal.
However, he collapsed on the night of our wedding and worsened his illness, passing away after three months of battling it.
It was very sad, especially since I had begun to think he was the one...
Living without my husband made me feel out of place.
Furthermore, my husband's brother, Yudals Azamaan, inherited the count house, which led to events that worsened my fear of men.
My brother-in-law began to direct his desires toward me.
During the day, he would stare at my body without reservation, and at night, he would even try to enter my bedroom.
Fortunately, Freina accompanied me to my new home, allowing me to be protected.
The primal gaze from Yudals filled my heart with terror and compelled me to decide to return to my family home.
Though I had once married, I could not return home without doing anything.
I took on the responsibilities of the steward in place of my brother, who lived in the royal capital, working to demonstrate my worth and earn my place.
I formed the Fourth Knight Order to protect not only myself but also those who share similar vulnerabilities.
Two years have passed since the order was established, but I know that this cannot continue.
Due to my fear of men, the Fourth Knight Order has inadvertently become a no-men zone.
I must provide them with opportunities to interact with men and overcome my own fear of them.
The First Knight Order is stationed in the royal capital as my brother's escort, the Second Knight Order is guarding the border town, and the Third Knight Order is securing the national border.
Each of these orders consists solely of men.

I have considered accepting male members from among them, but young male members would change their attitude upon learning that the order consists only of women, often harboring crude desires and attempting to harm the female members.
Since then, I have tried to create opportunities for interaction with men several times, but they would not meet my gaze, only staring at my body.
This recent incident may be an extension of that.
If I had accepted male members, perhaps they could have lived more safely without endangering the women.
I was supposed to protect them.
I should have been aware of that.
If only I could trust men, I might not have had to make the bitter choice of leaving Krush behind.
"Lana-sama, the carriage with Krush and the adventurer is arriving."
Freina, who had gone to rescue them, returned and explained the situation.
I had fled, and for a while, Krush and May fought against skeletons, buying time.
However, just when May was injured and it seemed hopeless, a male adventurer appeared and saved them.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3THrq2Y.jpeg
Moreover, he single-handedly defeated the White King.
I was unconscious due to the effects of the battle, so I didn't get to talk to him, but it seems he risked his life to save the two of them.
Upon hearing Freina's report, I hugged myself once more and steeled my resolve.
I had interacted with knights and noblemen before.
They are educated individuals. Even those types have directed rude gazes at me.
Adventurers, unlike nobles, are often uneducated and rough, so I cannot predict what they might demand.
However, I cannot neglect to express my gratitude to the one who saved my precious comrades.
I decided to mobilize the entire knight order to convey my thanks.
Adventurer Salt-sama, thank you for saving the lives of my comrades, including myself.
I am Lana Corias, the steward and sister of the lord.
The person who stepped down from the carriage was a somewhat unimpressive young man.
He seemed surprised by the assembled knight order.
I reminded myself that I was being protected by them as I approached adventurer Salt.
However, as I got closer, I felt a sense of discomfort.
Normally, I would soon feel a sense of disgust creeping up my back, and I would sense rude gazes directed at my chest, face, and legs.
Yet, he never once tried to look at my chest. Instead, he gazed intently into my eyes as I approached.
In his gaze, I sensed a hint of confusion, as if he were troubled or nervous.
Even as we began to speak, I never felt a gaze on my chest, and while his manners toward nobility were not perfect, they were certainly within an acceptable range.
I felt no sense of the roughness typical of adventurers; instead, the unimpressive aura he exuded conveyed a kindness that did not instill fear in me.
He was entirely different from past adventurers, showing me respect. I couldn't believe that such a gentleman existed.
Even my deceased husband had initially directed lustful gazes at me.
However, he eventually understood my circumstances and adjusted his behavior.
The adventurer Salt before me gently closed his eyes when I shifted my posture and stared into my eyes when I spoke or expressed my gratitude, never directing any lewd gaze my way.
The impact of this was greater than I had anticipated; I had never encountered such a gentlemanly man in my life.
Embarrassingly enough, I have a prominent chest that stands out.
I had felt a complex about my large chest, but his attitude seemed to understand all of my concerns, which made me happy.
"Freina, what do you think of Salt-sama's demeanor?"
After May guided Salt-sama to a high-class inn for hospitality, I decided to discuss him with Freina.
"Well, he may not be fully experienced, but he seems accustomed to interacting with nobility and women."
"Yes, indeed. This is the first time in my life that I’ve met a man who didn’t look at my chest first..."
I have suffered countless unpleasant experiences due to my prominent chest.
Yes.
He may have lived with women for many years and learned various ways to be considerate.
I have a complex about being taller than most women, but Salt-sama spoke to me at eye level.
It seems Freina was also not overlooked in his consideration.
I heard that Krush spoke with Salt-sama while he was waking up in the carriage.
It seems he is currently traveling alone, so perhaps he has also experienced a sad parting.
Just as I lost my husband, Salt-sama may have lost someone important to him as well.
I know well the sorrow of losing a loved one.
I lost my parents and my husband, and out of fear of men, I returned to my family home.
My only family is my brother, who is indifferent to me, while all other men are objects of fear.
If there are gentlemen like Salt-sama, perhaps I can overcome that fear.
"Freina, it seems the time for change has come for the Fourth Knight Order."
"What do you mean?"
"I would like to welcome Salt-sama as the healer for the Fourth Knight Order."
"You have tried to accept male members before, but are you considering Salt-sama?"
Yes, with his gentlemanly demeanor, I might be able to entrust the members to him.
Of course, it won't be immediate.
I am still afraid of men.
Moreover, it would be meaningless if the members do not accept Salt-sama.
Indeed, this is for my sake and for the members. I will pray that Salt-sama will cooperate while he is in Corias.
If you are that determined, I support you.
According to Krush, he possesses high-level healing skills and can use Holy Attribute magic, and he is also a high-ranking adventurer as a thief.
I will investigate him a bit more.
"Holy Attribute magic?"
"Yes. According to Krush, Salt-sama has a Holy Attribute."
Despite my requests to the church, they had not sent anyone with a Holy Attribute, but now an adventurer has come to us.
As the acting lord, I can no longer let Salt-sama slip away.
There is no doubt about his abilities.
"It seems I need to get closer to Salt-sama for my own sake."
Even as I steeled my resolve, my body trembled.
Though I imposed my circumstances upon him, I decided to invite Salt-sama to lunch today.
Perhaps he was only gentlemanly on the first day, and he might be different in reality.
If that were the case, I would keep a certain distance while still relying on his Holy Attribute power.
As the acting lord, I have learned to maintain the mindset of a noble.
However, meeting alone still terrified me, so I invited Freina and Krush to join us.
I learned in advance that Salt-sama intended to operate in Corias.
Knowing that he was willing to stay made it easier for me to consider requesting his assistance.
As I waited in the Rose Garden, our prideful garden, while having tea, May arrived with Salt-sama.
Unlike his adventurer attire, Salt-sama was dressed neatly, appearing clean and radiating a gentle aura, unlike the unimpressive adventurer from yesterday.
His demeanor suggested he might hail from a noble family, making me wonder if he had received a high-level education somewhere.
"Thank you for inviting me today. I am not accustomed to such occasions, so please forgive any rudeness on my part."
By acknowledging his own inexperience in his greeting, he lightened our mood.
Yet, every movement he made was graceful, and he never directed a rude gaze at the three of us.
He always either made eye contact with someone or kept his eyes closed.
His behavior showed consideration for women, and with the addition of formal attire, his charm was further enhanced.
As we enjoyed lunch, Salt-sama shared that he had been attacked by monsters in his village during his childhood and had been adventuring with two childhood friends.
So, that’s why he is accustomed to interacting with women.
I’m not sure if I’m accustomed to it, but the two of them taught me that women are sensitive to gazes and that I shouldn’t direct rude looks at them.
Haha, I’m a pathetic older brother.
It seems he had a very close relationship with his childhood friends.
He showed a happy expression when he spoke of them.
"Salt-sama, while you are in Corias, would you be willing to interact with the Fourth Knight Order?"
"Interaction?"
Yes.
I have judged that I can trust you, and I would like to ask if you could become the dedicated healer for the Fourth Knight Order.
"Huh? Dedicated to the Fourth Knight Order? Not to the Corias Territory?"
Yes.
The current Corias Territory is plagued by miasma, and it is dangerous everywhere.
As someone with a Holy Attribute, I would like to ask for your healing assistance if anything were to happen to the members of the Fourth Knight Order.
Of course, I will ensure you are paid properly.
Furthermore, the Fourth Knight Order consists solely of women.
Even if something goes wrong, we will not blame you.
"What? You won’t blame me for mistakes? What do you mean by that?"
This is the final test. I am almost certain he will pass, but I need to confirm that last one percent.
I may be seen as overly cautious, but my trauma runs deep.
Still, I want to believe.
I want to see how Salt-sama will respond.
"I mean it literally. I will grant you the authority to interact with the members of the Fourth Knight Order directly."
"That’s not acceptable! They have the right to choose their partners too!"
This man is truly a gentleman.
He does not jump at the chance to be praised or to seize a delicious opportunity; instead, he calmly analyzes the situation and shows concern for others.
Hehe, he continues to exceed my expectations. I understand.
I will absolutely welcome you as our healer.
